verdict.rationale: Agent Studio connects an LLM to Algolia and grounds responses in live index data, supporting summarizers, shopping assistants and conversational search. Recommend adds ML-based suggestions, and an MCP skill exposes analytics to agents. However, these mainly build end-user experiences or work through external agents. Search analytics shows metrics such as popular searches and no-result queries, but nothing shows it producing AI-generated insights. missing for 10: AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced to the operator inside the dashboard (e.g., AI analysis of analytics or relevance-tuning suggestions), independent or hands-on corroboration of Agent Studio.
